A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same REI-Bench study, with all 33 pages and Appendices A-D available. Text, embedded-image and rendered-page comparisons support a complete comparison; differences are confined to first-page author and version information.

before.justification: v3 reports original robot-planning experiments, prompting comparisons, success/error rates and inference-cost measurements in Section 4 and Appendix A.

after.justification: v4 retains the same original experimental results in Section 4 and Appendix A.

M1.justification: The dataset-construction pipeline and TOCC's instruction rewriting followed by constrained action selection are unchanged, including the prompting variants and Algorithm 1 in Appendix C.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same six ALFRED-derived household tasks in AI2-THOR, with identical Explicit/Mixed/Implicit RE levels and Standard/Noised/Short context conditions.

E2.justification: The same SayCan, DAG-Plan, HPE and LLM+P frameworks, prompting comparators and human baseline appear in the corresponding experiments. Comparator membership is unchanged in the main text and Appendix A.

E3.justification: The 1,000-task stratified evaluation subset, model configurations, context controls and evaluation procedures remain unchanged (Section 4.1; Appendix A).

E4.justification: The prompting ablations, context-removal comparisons, object-omission/execution-error analyses and success/failure cases are identical in Sections 4.3-4.4 and Appendices A.4-A.6.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version reports repeated-run counts, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: All reported success rates, error rates, token usage, latency measurements and qualitative findings match, including Figures 4-14 and Tables 2-3 and 6-8.

T1.justification: The RE/context definitions in Section 3.1 and counting constraints in Appendix B.4 and Table 9 are identical. No mathematical material is added, removed or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about REI-Bench, planning degradation under implicit referring expressions and TOCC's effectiveness.

C2.justification: Interpretations of object-omission failures and prompting behavior are unchanged. Section 5 retains the same limitations concerning simple tasks, simulator evaluation and missing multimodal and physical-robot validation.

D1.justification: Planner/model details, dataset-generation prompts, filtering rules, prompting templates and implementation pseudocode are unchanged in Appendices A-C. The project/code access statement also remains unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the benchmark-positioning comparison in Table 1 and the reference list are identical. No cited works or relationships to prior research change.

P1.justification: The first-page byline changes 'Jiangfei Yang' to 'Jianfei Yang'. The arXiv stamp changes from v3, dated 10 March 2026, to v4, dated 9 May 2026. All other prose and section structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1-14, Tables 1-9, captions and layout are unchanged. Pages 2-33 render identically; first-page differences are limited to the byline and version-stamp text.

improvement.justification: v4 corrects an author-name spelling and updates the version/date stamp. The scientific argument, empirical evidence, explanations and reproducibility information remain identical throughout the main text and appendices, leaving overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
